payload.prompt_core: This track is a high-energy Psytrance piece that fuses the driving force of classic Goa trance with modern, polished production techniques. It runs at 125 BPM in 4/4 time and is rooted in E♭ major, with occasional color from an E♭maj7 chord that adds a lush, slightly jazzy lift amid the relentless rhythm.
